title: canli-validation-mcp: an MCP server that validates backtests
description: A Model Context Protocol server that validates a trading backtest for an AI coding assistant: deflated Sharpe ratio, CSCV probability of backtest overfitting, minimum track record and backtest length, haircut Sharpe ratio and luck-equivalent trials, each checked against its source paper, with Ed25519-signed receipts and a statement of what each result does not establish.
